elements.label: Mouse cursor moving down and right off the table

pattern.description: Raw screen-recording micro-interaction: after clicking the Delivery view, the cursor sweeps away across the table, triggering row hover states while the sidebar focus ring settles into the selected state.
pattern.why_premium: Low premium value on its own; it is a settle beat that clears the cursor from the content so the next narration line lands on a clean table.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.to('.cursor', {x: 470, y: 245, duration: 0.2, ease: 'power1.inOut'}); toggle '.row.is-hover' via tl.set at times the cursor crosses each row; tl.set('.nav-delivery', {outlineColor: 'transparent', backgroundColor: '#f4f5f7'}).
build_hint.remotion: cursor x/y = interpolate(frame, [0, 6], [start, end], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad)}); row hover = cursorY within row bounds; nav outline switched off with a frame condition (no spring).

notes: Filmstrip frames are a crop of the lower-left region; end frame is the full UI. Low-energy event, mostly incidental screen-recording UI states.
